verses.text: <pb/><t>Ƙaƙa zinariya ta zama duhu!</t> <t>Ƙaƙa zinariya tsantsa ta sāke!</t> <t>Tsarkakakkun duwatsu kuma suna zube</t> <t>A kowane magamin titi. <pb/></t>
<t>Darajar samarin Sihiyona</t> <t>Ta kai tamanin zinariya tsantsa.</t> <t>To, ƙaƙa ake lissafinsu kamar tukwanen ƙasa,</t> <t>Aikin hannun maginin tukwane? <pb/></t>
<t>Ko diloli ma sukan ba 'ya'yansu mama,</t> <t>Su shayar da su.</t> <t>Amma mutanena sun zama kamar jiminai cikin jeji. <pb/></t>
<t>Harshen jinjiri ya liƙe a dasashinsa saboda ƙishi,</t> <t>'Yan yara suna roƙon abinci,</t> <t>Amma ba wanda ya ba su. <pb/></t>
<t>Su waɗanda suka ci abubuwa masu daɗi,</t> <t>Sun halaka a titi.</t> <t>Su waɗanda aka goye su da alharini,</t> <t>Yanzu suna kwance a kan tsibin toka. <pb/></t>
<t>Gama zunubin mutanena</t> <t>Ya fi zunubin Saduma,</t> <t>Wadda Ubangiji ya hallakar da ita nan da nan. <pb/></t>
<t>Keɓaɓɓunta sun fi dusar ƙanƙara tsabta,</t> <t>Sun kuma fi madara fari.</t> <t>Jikunansu sun fi murjani ja.</t> <t>Kyan tsarinsu yana kama da shuɗin yakutu. <pb/></t>
<t>Yanzu fuskokinsu sun fi kukunniya baƙi,</t> <t>Ba a iya fisshe su a titi ba,</t> <t>Fatar jikinsu ta liƙe wa ƙasusuwansu,</t> <t>Sun bushe kamar itace. <pb/></t>
<t>Gara ma waɗanda takobi ya kashe</t> <t>Da waɗanda yunwa ta kashe,</t> <t>Gama sun rame sarai saboda rashin abinci.</t>
<t>Mata masu juyayi, da hannuwansu</t> <t>Suka ɗauki 'ya'yansu, suka dafa,</t> <t>Suka zama musu abinci a lokacin halakar mutanena. <pb/></t>
<t>Ubangiji ya saki fushinsa,</t> <t>Ya zuba fushinsa mai zafi.</t> <t>Ya kunna wa Sihiyona wuta</t> <t>Wadda ta cinye harsashin gininta. <pb/></t>
<t>Sarakunan duniya da mazaunanta ba su gaskata,</t> <t>Cewa abokan gaba ko maƙiya</t> <t>Za su iya shiga ƙofofin Urushalima ba. <pb/></t>
<t>Dalili kuwa saboda zunuban annabawa ne,</t> <t>Da muguntar firistoci,</t> <t>Waɗanda suka kashe adalai. <pb/></t>
<t>Sun yi ta kai da kawowa a titi kamar makafi,</t> <t>Sun ƙazantu da jini</t> <t>Har ba wanda zai taɓa rigunansu. <pb/></t>

<t>Mutane suka yi ta yi musu ihu,</t> <t>Suna cewa, “Ku tafi, ku ƙazamai,</t> <t>Ku tafi, ku tafi, kada ku taɓa mu!”</t> <t>Don haka suka zama korarru, masu kai da kawowa.</t> <t>A cikin sauran al'umma mutane suna cewa,</t> <t>“Ba za su ƙara zama tare da mu ba.” <pb/></t>
<t>Ubangiji kansa ya watsar da su,</t> <t>Ba zai ƙara kulawa da su ba.</t> <t>Ba su darajanta firistoci ba,</t> <t>Ba su kuma kula da dattawa ba. <pb/></t>
<t>Idanunmu sun gaji</t> <t>Da zuba ido a banza don samun taimako,</t> <t>Mun zuba ido</t> <t>Ga al'ummar da ba za ta iya cetonmu ba. <pb/></t>
<t>Ana bin sawayenmu,</t> <t>Don haka ba mu iya tafiya a titunanmu ba.</t> <t>Ƙarshenmu ya yi kusa,</t> <t>Kwanakinmu sun ƙare,</t> <t>Gama ƙarshenmu ya zo. <pb/></t>
<t>Masu runtumarmu sun fi gaggafar da take tashi sama sauri.</t> <t>Sun fafare mu a kan duwatsu,</t> <t>Suna fakonmu a cikin jeji. <pb/></t>
<t>Shi wanda muke dogara gare shi,</t> <t>Wato zaɓaɓɓe na Ubangiji, ya auka cikin raminsu,</t> <t>Shi wanda muka ce,</t> <t>“A ƙarƙashin inuwarsa ne za mu zauna a cikin sauran al'umma.” <pb/></t>
<t>Ki yi farin ciki, ki yi murna, ke Edom,</t> <t>Wadda kike zaune cikin ƙasar Uz.</t> <t>Amma fa za a ba ki ƙoƙo ki sha,</t> <t>Ki bugu har ki yi tsiraici. <pb/></t>
<t>Ya Sihiyona, hukunci a kan muguntarki ya ƙare,</t> <t>Ba zai ƙara barinki a ƙasar bauta ba.</t> <t>Amma zai hukunta ki saboda muguntarki, ya Edom,</t> <t>Zai tone zunubanki.</t>
